rewards: Access to the underground White Wolf Mountain passage
Ability to catch minnows in The Fishing Guild.

st.t: Talk to Vestri just north of Catherby.
s: I was wondering what was down those stairs?
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.
And how am I meant to do that?

st.t: If you have no garlic, take some from the table in the house south-west of the bank in Seers' Village. It reappears about every 30 seconds.

If you have no red vine worm, bring a spade to McGrubor's Wood, west of Seers' Village. Squeeze through the loose railing on the north side, watching out for the aggressive level 44 guard dogs. Use your spade on the red vines just west of the fairy ring and collect at least 2 red vine worms.

If you have no fishing rod, buy one for 5 coins from Grandpa Jack in the house just outside the Hemenster gate. Then enter Hemenster with your fishing pass, through the gate just west of the Ranging Guild. A combat bracelet teleports you to the Ranging Guild.
s: Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
Very fair, I'll buy that rod!

st.t: Speak to Bonzo to start the competition.
Put garlic in the third pipe from the gate, on the south wall of the building to the north. Finish the dialogue.
Wait for the Sinister Stranger to move away from the pipes, then catch the winning fish at the fishing spot near them.
Speak to Bonzo again after you have caught the winning fish.
s: I have this big fish. Is it enough to win?

st.t: Bring Vestri just north of Catherby the trophy.
